verdict.rationale: Dagster OSS is open source and documented for self-hosted deployment, including a Docker deployment guide describing webserver, daemon, and code location containers running long-term — a clear self-host architecture. Community evidence corroborates real-world self-hosted use (dagster/dbt/DuckDB stack). Missing for 10: independent verification of production-scale self-hosted deployments (e.g., Kubernetes at scale) and more detail on self-hosted feature parity vs Dagster+.
